claimBoundary.establishes: whether a fair same-v2-X robust-Y vs v2-Y P1 bakeoff is structurally runnable on the local unbrainless87 panel under frozen zero-engine inventory gates
forbids: reinterpretation of sealed rating Stage1 verdicts
claimBoundary.exploratoryNote: Lower rating-moderation panel is visible and sealed for Stage1; this reuse is exploratory analysis-lock only and cannot confirm or authorize product.
claimBoundary.phase0Scope: zero-engine inventory and prefix-recurrence diagnostics only; Y not generated

decisionUnits.gameFilter: normalized game.color === subjectColor with production collapse exclusion when available

windows.cutoffRule: cutoffs at 30,40,50,... while exactly 10 future games remain
windows.maxCutoffsRule: if more eligible cutoffs, keep the latest 4 deterministically
windows.trainRule: all games strictly before cutoff index
windows.futureRule: exactly the next 10 games after cutoff
windows.nonOverlapRule: strideGames equals futureWindowGames so future windows do not overlap

groundedInventory.selectionRule: deepest qualifying prefix on newest train game; tie-break longer then lexical UCI path

prefixSupport.rule: exact UCI prefix match on train games only
prefixSupport.distinctGames: count distinct gameId with ucis beginning with prefix
prefixSupport.distinctDates: count distinct normalized datestamp/day among supporting games

futureRecurrence.rule: factual prefix re-entry over the 10-game future window only

primary.name: same-v2-x-robust-y
primary.xRule: identical frozen v2 train-only prefix X per unit
primary.yIsolation: hold X fixed; compare robust-Y vs v2-Y only

futureP1.auditRule: d18 only for intrinsic audit; no evaluation reuse in selection
futureP1.replyUncertainty: union of Stockfish best defences and rating-band Maia replies; no target future reply probabilities

intrinsicV.formula: leave-one-reply-out equal-weight concession vs best defence from our perspective at d18

unitWeight.abstainRule: one card or abstain; abstain sets V=0 and W=0

primaryDelta.formula: mean W(robustY) - mean W(v2Y) on same X units
primaryDelta.xFixedNote: futurePrefixEntryBinary identical because X is fixed

futureP1.phase1aRequirement: robust-Y must differ from v2-Y on enough units; not assessed in Phase0
futureP1.conditionalExploratoryNote: Future recurrence band [0.10,0.90] conditions same-panel P1 only; cannot estimate unconditional/generalizable effect or confirm anything; does not tune Y.
futureP1.cutoffCorrelationNote: Up to 4 nested-train cutoffs per player-color are correlated; future P1 must use player-cluster/hierarchical bootstrap and cannot treat cutoffs as independent.

reportHash.canonicalJson: pretty-printed 2-space JSON with reportSha256 field omitted

lifecycle.protocolSha256Convention: raw protocol file bytes at freeze; canonical JSON helper is synthetic-only
